description:
David Reynolds Estate Agents are delighted to present this superb 4-bedroom semi-detached residence extending to c. 118 m2 ideally positioned on an elevated site just 1km from Strandhill Village and 8km from Sligo Town.

Presented in turnkey condition and being sold as seen, this spacious family home boasts an extra-large front driveway with ample parking and a generous rear garden enjoying stunning views overlooking the iconic Knocknarea Mountain.

The property offers bright, well-proportioned accommodation throughout and is ideally located close to Strandhill`s renowned beach, cafés, schools, sporting amenities and coastal walks.

 Excellent transport links are available via the Bus Éireann S2 service, which operates hourly between Strandhill and Sligo Town from early morning until late evening.

A fantastic opportunity to acquire a quality home in one of Sligo`s most sought-after coastal locations.

Viewing is highly recommended.
